elements.inner_text:
Problem Listen
        Self-supervised pre-training reuses masked modeling and contrastive learning from vision and language. On time series both misfire: randomly masking a series or scoring series-wise similarity distorts or neglects the temporal correlations intrinsic and crucial to time-series data.
        Masking shatters smooth temporal structure; contrastive learning ignores fine-grained within-series correlations and needs augmentations hard to design for time series.
      
      
        Motivation Listen
        
          Unlabeled data is exploding. IoT sensors and wearables stream ever-growing volumes of time series, ready for label-free pre-training at scale.
          Prior work wastes the signal. Each subseries is treated in isolation, overlooking the chronological relationship between temporally distanced observations.
        
        A method that explicitly emphasizes temporal-correlation modeling could unlock this data for downstream tasks.
        Time-series pre-training paradigms: (a) masked modeling reconstructs a masked series; (b) contrastive learning scores similarity; (c) TimeSiam reconstructs the masked current series from a sampled past observation.

elements.inner_text:
Method Listen
        
          Sample a past and current subseries from the same series.
          Mask the current subseries with a simple augmentation.
          Reconstruct: shared Siamese encoders + a cross-attention decoder rebuild the current series from the past.
          Lineage embeddings indexed by past→current distance span many temporal gaps.
        
        Lrec=∥xcurr−x^curr∥22\mathcal{L}_{\text{rec}} = \lVert x^{\text{curr}} - \hat{x}^{\text{curr}} \rVert_2^2Lrec​=∥xcurr−x^curr∥22​Past-to-current reconstruction is the sole objective — forcing the model to internalize how distant moments correlate.
        TimeSiam pre-trains shared Siamese encoders on past/current subseries and fuses learnable lineage embeddings; fine-tuning averages (fixed input) or concatenates (extended input) the lineages.
      
      
        Dataset / Benchmark Listen
        13 benchmarks over two tasks, plus two newly constructed large-scale multi-domain corpora (TSLD-500M, TSLD-1G with 13.9M examples) for cross-domain pre-training.
        
          ETT×4WeatherElectricityTrafficExchange
          ADTDBrainPTB
          TSLD-500MTSLD-1G

        Reframe time-series pre-training as past-to-current reconstruction between Siamese subseries with learnable lineage embeddings — capturing the temporal correlations masking and contrastive methods miss, for simple, general, state-of-the-art transfer across tasks and domains. Backbone-agnostic on iTransformer, PatchTST and TCN.
